en.summary: Data Center supplied most incremental revenue and a growing share of segment profit, while Gaming weakened and cash conversion lagged earnings. The investment case in the reported quarter therefore has two different sides: strong server/AI operating leverage and a much smaller free-cash-flow outcome. Upcoming revenue guidance needs to be tested against margins, collections and capital requirements.
findings: Revenue was $13.377B, changing 44.679% YoY. GAAP diluted EPS was $1.46 versus $0.75 a year ago. These are realized standalone results for 2026-06-28–2026-09-26; changes in the business mix and special items need to be evaluated alongside the consolidated comparison.

GAAP operating income was $2.832B. Dividing it by revenue gives an operating margin of about 21.171%, versus 13.736% a year ago. The financial table separately retains GAAP gross margin of 53.898%. Gross and operating margins measure different expense levels; neither measures cash left after capital investment or the return earned on the installed asset base.

Continuing-operations OCF was $1.202B versus $1.788B a year ago. Cash capex rose to $648M from $258M, reducing FCF to $554M from $1.530B, about a 63.8% decline. The prior-year total-operations OCF also included discontinued operations; using that larger number would mix scopes. The cash gap warrants checking receivables, inventory and payment timing without assuming one cause.

Data Center revenue rose from $4.341B to $8.546B, contributing $4.205B of growth against $4.131B of consolidated growth. Declines elsewhere offset part of that increase. Data Center operating income rose to $2.882B from $1.074B; the segment’s approximately 33.7% operating margin should be read as a segment measure, before corporate/unallocated costs.

The three operating segments generated $3.908B of operating profit in total, while All Other costs of $1.076B reconcile that to GAAP operating income of $2.832B. Company non-GAAP EPS of $2.09 exceeds GAAP EPS of $1.46. Segment strength and adjusted profitability therefore require the acquisition-intangible, compensation and other reconciliation items to remain visible.

Management guides Q4 revenue to $17B plus or minus 3%, equivalent to $16.49B–$17.51B, with non-GAAP gross margin of 55%. That midpoint implies substantial sequential growth, but it remains a forecast. Delivery timing, supply, customer collections and the gap between GAAP and adjusted margins must be checked before treating the guided revenue as realized cash-generating growth.

segments.name: Data Center
segments.text: Revenue was $8.546B, up approximately 96.9% YoY, and operating income $2.882B. The segment includes server CPUs, AI accelerators and other data-center products; it is broader than GPU revenue alone.

segments.name: Client and Gaming
segments.text: Combined revenue was $3.722B versus $4.048B. Client revenue increased to $2.949B from $2.750B, while Gaming fell to $773M from $1.298B. The combined decline therefore masks different demand trends, and the two product figures must not be added again to the segment total.

segments.name: Embedded
segments.text: Revenue was $1.109B versus $857M, and operating income $453M versus $283M. Recovery here supports diversification, but the much smaller revenue base means it does not currently replace the group’s dependence on Data Center growth.

limitations: Analysis uses the listed official filings, releases and financial attachments; official call text has not been fully reviewed.
Product/geographic categories, reportable segments and adjusted measures retain their disclosed perimeters and must not be double-counted or substituted for consolidated GAAP results.
Cash flows are standalone; cumulative disclosures are differenced across adjacent periods. Issuer adjustments, leases and incentives are identified in metric definitions.
No pre-release consensus snapshot was preserved. Management guidance and analytical inferences are distinct from realized results.

metrics.label: GAAP gross margin
metrics.definition: GAAP gross profit divided by quarterly revenue.

metrics.label: Calculated free cash flow
metrics.definition: Standalone quarterly operating cash flow less cash capital purchases.
